title: UpgradeOps
description: Request/result bodies for the upgrade/* operations (spec.md §8.4). Session-less: pure document-in, document-out.

pact.description: A v1-v4 pact document to convert to a Janus contract (rules in design 2.5).

findings.description: Lossy or judgement-call conversion spots, for 'janus upgrade' to show its work. An empty list is a claim: the conversion was exact.

items.title: UpgradeFinding

code.description: Open vocabulary; an unknown code is displayed, never dispatched on. Codes are listed in contract-file spec §8.4.

kind.description: 'lossy' means the contract now says less than the pact did; 'judgement' means the converter chose between readings the pact did not distinguish; 'note' means neither, and is worth reading anyway.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the *source pact* — the file the author is looking at.

message.description: Prose, addressed to the author of the pact.

target.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the converted contract, where the source construct ended up, when there is such a place.

items.description: One conversion finding. The normative definition is contract-file spec §8.4 (its schemas/v1/upgrade-findings.schema.json); this mirrors it so a host validating a frame against this file alone is checking the same document.
